scope: Cache broadcast FP32 coefficient vectors per channel within a request; share magnitude/zero/nonfinite product classifications and accumulate nonfinite predicates. QFloat/FP32 rounding, ordered accumulation, tensor layout and units unchanged.

comparison.kind: Sequential one-crop A/B pilots, with three timing frames per variant and baseline controls before and after. Not an alternating statistical benchmark.

limitations: Four crops from one scene, not broad accuracy qualification.
Sequential timing samples; host variance affects complete frame latency.
Scalar coefficient caching and masks alone did not materially improve the first pilot; broadcast reuse plus masks selected from measured results.
No new numeric format, precision, accumulation-order, unit-cap, timeout or reservation change.
